title: High-Probability Regret Bounds for Feel-Good Thompson Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.19513v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feel-good Thompson sampling (FGTS) augments the posterior of vanilla Thompson sampling with an exploration term that favors reward functions with high predicted optimal values. This modification achieves minimax-optimal regret up to logarithmic factors in linear contextual bandits, but existing analyses of its two standard variants establish regret guarantees in expectation. In this paper, we derive the first high-probability regret bounds for both cumulative and current-step FGTS in contextual bandits with general realizable function approximation. Our bounds depend on the corresponding decoupling coefficients and the prior mass near the true reward function. In the $d$-dimensional linear setting, both variants satisfy $\mathrm{Regret}(T)=O\big(d\sqrt T\log(2T)+\sqrt T\log(1/\delta)\big)$ with probability at least $1-\delta$, where $T$ is the time horizon. translated_title: Feel-Good Thompson 采样的高概率遗憾界
translated_abstract: Feel-Good Thompson 采样（FGTS）通过在标准 Thompson 采样的后验中加入一个探索项来增强，该探索项倾向于偏向预测最优值较高的奖励函数。这一改进在线性上下文老虎机中实现了除对数因子外极小极大最优的遗憾，但现有关于其两种标准变体的分析仅建立了期望意义下的遗憾保证。在本文中，我们在具有一般可实现函数逼近的上下文老虎机中，首次为累积型（cumulative）和当前步型（current-step）两种 FGTS 推导出了高概率遗憾界。我们的界取决于相应的解耦系数以及真实奖励函数附近的先验概率质量。在 d 维线性设置下，两种变体都以至少 1-δ 的概率满足 Regret(T)=O(d√T log(2T)+√T log(1/δ))，其中 T 为时间范围。该界在维度和时间范围依赖性上与基于……的算法相匹配。
tldr: 本文首次为 Feel-Good Thompson 采样在上下文老虎机中建立了高概率遗憾界，在线性设置下达到了与最优算法在维度和时间范围依赖性上相匹配的遗憾保证。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the first high-probability regret bounds for both variants of Feel-Good Thompson Sampling in contextual bandits, matching the dimension and horizon dependence of optimal algorithms in the linear setting.
